recipes.dish_name: Seared Tuna & White Bean Power Bowl

nutrition.highlights: ULTRA HIGH **protein** from tuna (40g) + beans (16g). Extremely rich in **Omega-3 fatty acids**. High in iron, selenium, and B vitamins. Performance athlete-level nutrition.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Fresh tuna steaks 350g (sushi-grade if eating rare)
2. Cannellini beans 2 tins (800g), drained
3. Cherry tomatoes 250g, halved
4. Garlic 4 cloves (2 minced, 2 sliced)
5. Baby spinach 3 cups
6. Lemon zest and juice 1 lemon
7. Fresh basil 1/2 cup torn
8. Parmesan 30g grated
9. Olive oil 4 tbsp
10. Balsamic vinegar 1 tbsp
11. Dijon mustard 1 tsp
12. Salt and pepper
13. Sesame seeds for crusting tuna
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

1. **Ninja SmartLid:** Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add 2 tbsp olive oil.
2. Add sliced garlic, cook 1 min until golden.
3. Add cherry tomatoes, cook 3 min until starting to burst.
4. Add cannellini beans, lemon zest, salt, pepper.
5. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK, 5 min.
6. Quick release. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ, add spinach, stir until wilted (2 min).
7. Stir in half the basil, lemon juice, Parmesan. Keep warm.
8. **While beans cook:** Pat tuna steaks very dry. Season with salt, pepper.
9. Press sesame seeds onto both sides of tuna.
10. Brush with 1 tbsp olive oil.
11. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Preheat 3 min at 200°C. Add tuna steaks.
12. Air fry at 200°C for 6-8 min (6 min for rare, 8 min for medium-rare, 12 min for well done).
13. **Make dressing:** Whisk remaining olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, Dijon mustard.
14. **To serve:** Divide warm bean mixture among bowls.
15. Slice tuna steaks thickly. Arrange over beans.
16. Drizzle with dressing, top with remaining basil.

**Protein tip:** Fresh tuna has MORE protein than chicken breast! Searing keeps it moist. The sesame crust adds texture and healthy fats.

**Time:** 30 minutes total
**Protein:** 56g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of seared sesame-crusted tuna slices (pink in the middle) over a bed of white beans with tomatoes and wilted spinach, garnished with basil.

recipes.ingredients:

3. Broccoli 300g, cut into florets
4. Garlic 4 cloves (2 minced, 2 whole)
5. Vegetable broth 2.5 cups
6. Lemon juice and zest 1 lemon
7. Fresh dill 1/3 cup
8. Greek yogurt 1/2 cup
9. Dijon mustard 2 tsp
10. Tahini 2 tbsp
11. Cumin 1 tsp
12. Olive oil

recipes.instructions:

3. When done, quick release. Drain excess liquid if any. Remove garlic cloves, mash and return to lentils.
4. Stir in lemon zest, half the dill, 1 tbsp olive oil. Keep warm.
5. **While lentils cook:** Season salmon with salt, pepper, lemon juice. Brush with olive oil.

11. Drizzle generously with yogurt-tahini sauce.

**Protein:** 54g per serving

recipes.dish_name: Double Protein Salmon with Herbed Cottage Cheese

nutrition.highlights: ULTRA HIGH **protein** from salmon (35g) + cottage cheese (17g). Rich in **Omega-3 fatty acids**, calcium, and complete amino acids. Low carb, muscle-building powerhouse.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Salmon fillets 400g (2 large fillets)
2. Cottage cheese 200g (high protein variety)
3. Baby potatoes 300g, halved
4. Asparagus or green beans 200g
5. Fresh dill 1/4 cup chopped
6. Fresh chives 2 tbsp chopped
7. Garlic 2 cloves minced
8. Lemon zest and juice 1 lemon
9. Capers 1 tbsp
10. Olive oil
11. Dijon mustard 1 tsp
12. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:

3. **While potatoes cook:** Season salmon with salt, pepper, lemon zest. Brush with olive oil.
4. Trim asparagus/beans, toss with 1 tsp olive oil.
5. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** After potatoes cook 10 min, add salmon skin-side down. Air fry at 180°C for 10 min.
6. **After salmon cooks 5 min:** Add asparagus/beans around salmon. Continue cooking. Use SYNC FINISH so all finish together.
7. **Make herbed cottage cheese:** Mix cottage cheese, dill, chives, minced garlic, lemon juice, capers, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper.

9. Top salmon generously with herbed cottage cheese (serves as creamy sauce).

**Protein:** 52g per serving

recipes.instructions:

**Protein:** 50g per serving

recipes.dish_name: Greek Baked Ricotta with Eggs & Lentils

nutrition.highlights: VERY HIGH **protein** from ricotta (20g) + eggs (18g) + lentils (8g). Exceptional calcium source. Complete amino acids. Vegetarian protein powerhouse.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Ricotta cheese 300g (full fat for richness)
2. Eggs 6
3. Cooked lentils 1 cup (or 1 tin, drained)
4. Spinach 2 cups chopped
5. Sundried tomatoes 1/3 cup chopped
6. Feta cheese 80g crumbled
7. Garlic 3 cloves minced
8. Fresh oregano 2 tbsp (or 1 tsp dried)
9. Lemon zest 1 lemon
10. Pine nuts 2 tbsp
11. Olive oil
12. Wholegrain bread or pita
13. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid (if cooking lentils from scratch) + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

**If using dried lentils:**
1. **Ninja SmartLid:** Add 1 cup dried lentils, 2.5 cups water, pinch salt.
2. Lock lid, PRESSURE COOK 10 min. Quick release. Drain and set aside.

**If using canned lentils, start here:**
3. In large bowl, mix ricotta, 2 eggs (lightly beaten), minced garlic, oregano, lemon zest, salt, pepper until smooth.
4. Fold in cooked/canned lentils, chopped spinach, sundried tomatoes, half the feta.
5. Pour mixture into oven-safe dish that fits in air fryer (or 2 smaller dishes for both zones).
6. Make 4 wells in the mixture. Crack remaining 4 eggs into wells.
7. Top with remaining feta and pine nuts. Drizzle with olive oil.
8. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Place dish in basket. Air fry at 170°C for 15-18 min until eggs set (yolks still slightly runny) and top golden.
9. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** Add thick slices of bread. Toast at 180°C for 4 min. Time so bread finishes when eggs do.
10. Let rest 3 min before serving.
11. Serve directly from dish with toasted bread.

**Protein tip:** Ricotta has nearly as much protein as Greek yogurt but creamier. Baking it creates a texture like crustless quiche.

**Time:** 35 minutes total (25 min if using canned lentils)
**Protein:** 46g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of a baked ricotta casserole with visible eggs nestled in creamy white ricotta mixture, dotted with sundried tomatoes and feta, topped with toasted pine nuts.

nutrition.highlights: VERY HIGH **protein** from tofu (32g) + quinoa (8g) + Greek yogurt (4g). Complete amino acids. High in calcium and iron. Vegan-adaptable powerhouse breakfast/lunch.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Extra-firm tofu 450g block, pressed
2. Quinoa 1 cup
3. Cherry tomatoes 200g, halved
4. Mushrooms 200g, sliced
5. Baby spinach 3 cups
6. Nutritional yeast 3 tbsp (gives cheesy flavor + B12)
7. Turmeric 1/2 tsp (for golden color)
8. Garlic powder 1 tsp
9. Smoked paprika 1/2 tsp
10. Greek yogurt 1/2 cup (or vegan alternative)
11. Fresh chives 2 tbsp
12. Olive oil
13. Salt and pepper
14. Avocado 1, sliced (optional)
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

**TOFU 101 - How to make it taste amazing:**
1. **Key:** Press tofu for 10 min between paper towels with heavy object on top. Removes water = better texture.
2. **Ninja SmartLid:** Add 1 cup quinoa and 1.5 cups water. Lock lid, select RICE mode (12 min).
3. **While quinoa cooks:** Crumble pressed tofu with hands into bite-size pieces (like scrambled eggs).
4. In bowl, mix crumbled tofu with nutritional yeast, turmeric, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, pepper.
5. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil until well coated (this is your 'marinade').
6. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Spread seasoned tofu in basket. Air fry at 190°C for 15 min, shaking every 5 min until golden and slightly crispy.
7. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** Toss mushrooms and cherry tomatoes with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, pepper. Air fry at 180°C for 12 min. Use SYNC FINISH.
8. **Last 2 min of cooking:** Add spinach to mushroom/tomato basket, let wilt.
9. **Assemble bowls:** Quinoa base, top with golden tofu scramble, roasted vegetables.
10. Dollop Greek yogurt, sprinkle chives, add avocado if using.

**Tofu tip:** Nutritional yeast + turmeric makes tofu taste eggy and cheesy! Pressing is crucial - wet tofu = mushy tofu. Air frying makes it crispy on edges.

**Time:** 32 minutes total
**Protein:** 44g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of a bowl with fluffy quinoa topped with golden, crumbly tofu scramble, roasted mushrooms and tomatoes, wilted spinach, and a dollop of yogurt.

nutrition.highlights: VERY HIGH **protein** from tempeh (31g) + quinoa (8g) + tahini (3g). Complete amino acids. Rich in probiotics, fiber, and iron. Fermented soy is easier to digest.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Tempeh 300g block
2. Quinoa 1 cup
3. Edamame 1 cup (frozen, shelled)
4. Red cabbage 2 cups shredded
5. Carrot 1 large, julienned
6. Cucumber 1, sliced
7. Soy sauce or tamari 3 tbsp
8. Maple syrup 1 tbsp
9. Rice vinegar 2 tbsp
10. Sesame oil 1 tbsp
11. Tahini 3 tbsp
12. Garlic 2 cloves minced
13. Fresh coriander 1/4 cup

15. Olive oil
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

**TEMPEH 101 - How to prepare:**
1. Cut tempeh into 1.5cm cubes or thick slices.
2. **KEY STEP:** Steam first to remove bitterness and help marinade absorb.
3. **Ninja SmartLid:** Add 1 cup water and steamer basket. Add tempeh cubes.
4. Lock lid, select STEAM mode, 5 min. Remove tempeh, pat dry.
5. **Make marinade:** Mix soy sauce, maple syrup, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic.
6. Toss steamed tempeh in marinade. Let sit 5 min (longer is better).
7. **Rinse SmartLid pot.** Add 1 cup quinoa and 1.5 cups water. Lock lid, select RICE mode (12 min).
8. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Add marinated tempeh (reserve marinade). Air fry at 200°C for 15 min, shaking every 5 min until golden and crispy.

10. **Make tahini dressing:** Mix tahini, remaining rice vinegar, 3 tbsp water, salt until smooth.
11. **Assemble bowls:** Quinoa base, top with crispy tempeh, edamame, cabbage, carrot, cucumber.
12. Drizzle with tahini dressing and reserved marinade.
13. Garnish with coriander and sesame seeds.

**Tempeh tip:** Steaming removes bitterness - this is the secret! Air frying makes it crispy like bacon. Tempeh has more protein than tofu.

**Time:** 34 minutes total
**Protein:** 42g per serving

**Protein:** 40g per serving

recipes.ingredients:
1. Sardines in olive oil 2 tins (220g total, drained)
2. Chickpeas 2 tins (800g), drained and dried
3. Cherry tomatoes 200g, halved
4. Garlic 4 cloves (2 whole, 2 minced)
5. Fresh parsley 1/2 cup chopped
6. Lemon juice and zest 1 lemon
7. Capers 2 tbsp
8. Kalamata olives 1/2 cup, chopped
9. Greek yogurt 1/2 cup
10. Smoked paprika 1 tsp
11. Cumin 1/2 tsp
12. Olive oil
13. Wholegrain sourdough bread 4 thick slices
14. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

1. Pat chickpeas very dry. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper.
2. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Spread chickpeas in basket. Air fry at 200°C for 18 min, shaking every 6 min until crispy.
3. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** Toss cherry tomatoes and 2 whole garlic cloves with 1 tsp olive oil. Air fry at 180°C for 12 min.
4. After tomatoes cook 8 min, add bread slices to Zone 2. Toast alongside tomatoes for final 4 min. Use SYNC FINISH.
5. **While cooking:** In bowl, mash sardines roughly with fork (keep some chunks).
6. Add minced garlic, capers, olives, lemon zest, half the parsley, 1 tbsp olive oil. Mix gently.
7. When tomatoes done, squeeze roasted garlic from skins into sardine mixture. Add half the roasted tomatoes. Fold gently.
8. **Make yogurt sauce:** Mix Greek yogurt, lemon juice, salt, pepper.
9. **To serve:** Spread yogurt sauce on toasted bread.
10. Top with sardine-chickpea mixture.
11. Add crispy chickpeas, remaining roasted tomatoes, remaining parsley.
12. Drizzle with olive oil.

**Protein tip:** Sardines are incredibly nutrient-dense - more Omega-3s than salmon! Eat the bones for calcium. The 'smash' style makes them less fishy.

**Time:** 28 minutes total
**Protein:** 38g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of rustic open-faced sandwiches with mashed sardines and chickpeas on toasted sourdough, topped with crispy chickpeas and roasted tomatoes.

recipes.dish_name: Baked Potato with Salad and Barramundi

nutrition.highlights: High in **protein** (from barramundi). Good source of carbohydrates (potatoes) for energy, and vitamins and fiber from the fresh salad vegetables. Barramundi is also a good source of **Omega-3 fatty acids**.

recipes.ingredients:

2. Cucumber 1, diced
3. Tomatoes 2, diced
4. Capsicum 1, diced

2. Chickpeas 1 tin, drained and patted dry
3. Mixed salad leaves 4 cups

5. Cucumber 1, diced

3. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Add chickpeas. Air fry at 200°C for 15 min, shaking every 5 min.

recipes.dish_name: Crispy Air Fryer Tofu Tahini Bowl

2. Quinoa 1 cup
3. Cherry tomatoes 200g halved
4. Cucumber 1, diced
5. Tahini 3 tbsp
6. Lemon juice 2 tbsp
7. Garlic 2 cloves minced
8. Fresh parsley 1/2 cup chopped
9. Olive oil

8. **Assemble bowls:** Divide quinoa between 2-3 bowls. Top with crispy tofu, roasted tomatoes, cucumber, parsley.

nutrition.highlights: Good source of Carbohydrates for energy. Provides **protein** (from tuna and cream cheese) and healthy fats (from avocado). Contains iodine from nori.

recipes.ingredients:

2. Rice 370g (about 1.5 cups uncooked)
3. Tuna 1 can, drained
4. Soft cheese (cream cheese) 360g
5. Cucumber 1, julienned
6. Nori sheets 4
recipes.instructions:

1. Add 1.5 cups rice and 1.8 cups water to pot.
2. Lock lid, select RICE mode (white rice setting).
3. When done, let natural release 10 min. Spread rice on tray to cool to room temperature.
4. **While rice cools:** Mix tuna with some cream cheese (about 50g) in bowl.
5. Slice avocado thinly.
6. Julienne cucumber into matchstick strips.
7. Lay out plastic wrap on flat surface.
8. Place 1 nori sheet on plastic wrap.
9. Spread thin layer of cream cheese on nori.
10. Spread layer of rice on top (about 1cm thick).
11. Place another piece of plastic wrap on top.
12. Flip entire thing so nori is on top, rice on bottom.
13. Remove top plastic wrap.
14. On the nori side, arrange line of tuna mixture, avocado, cucumber.
15. Using plastic wrap, roll tightly like sushi.
16. Wrap in plastic, refrigerate 30 min to set.
17. Slice with sharp knife into 2cm pieces.
18. Repeat with remaining ingredients.

**Time saved:** 8 minutes; perfect sushi rice every time
recipes.image_description: Image of a sliced sushi sandwich (pressed sushi) with visible layers of rice, nori, tuna mixture, avocado, and cucumber.

nutrition.highlights: Provides a good balance of carbohydrates (rice) and fiber (eggplant). Contains **protein** (cheese) and various vitamins from vegetables. A hearty and satisfying baked dish.

2. Mozzarella 200g, torn or shredded
3. Rice 1 cup uncooked
4. Capsicum 1, diced
5. Cheese (cheddar or mixed) 100g grated
6. Tomatoes 2 large, diced
7. Garlic 3 cloves minced
8. Olive oil
9. Italian herbs
10. Salt and pepper

11. Fill eggplant halves with rice mixture.

nutrition.highlights: High in fiber and **plant-based protein** (from lentils). Excellent source of carbohydrates for energy (from potatoes). Rich in vitamins A and C from carrots and tomatoes, and potassium from potatoes.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Cherry tomatoes 250g halved
2. Potatoes 6 large
3. Milk 1/2 cup
4. Lentils 1 can
5. Italian herbs
6. Tomato passata 400g
7. Vegetable broth 1 cup
8. Celery 2 stalks, diced
9. Carrot 1, diced
10. Basil pesto 2 tbsp
11. Parmesan cheese
12. Butter 2 tbsp
13. Olive oil
14. Onion 1, diced
15. Garlic 3 cloves minced
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid Multi Cooker (Two Batch Method):**

**Batch 1 - Potatoes:**
1. Peel and cube potatoes. Add to pot with 1 cup water and steamer basket.
2. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 8 min.
3. Quick release when done. Drain well.
4. **Use Kenwood Titanium Chef:** Transfer potatoes to mixing bowl with butter and milk. Mix on low speed until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside in warm bowl.

**Batch 2 - Lentils:**
5. Clean pot. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add olive oil.
6. Sauté onion, carrot, celery 5 min until soft.
7. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
8. Add cherry tomatoes, cook 3 min.
9. Add passata, vegetable broth, Italian herbs.
10. Add lentils (drained and rinsed).
11. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 5 min.
12. Quick release when done.
13. Stir in basil pesto. Season with salt and pepper.
14. Serve lentil mixture over mashed potatoes.
15. Top with grated parmesan.

**Time saved:** 10 minutes; both components cook faster
recipes.image_description: Image of creamy mashed potatoes topped with a rich, rustic lentil and vegetable tomato stew, garnished with Parmesan cheese.

nutrition.highlights: Rich and creamy carbohydrate source. Provides fiber and B vitamins from mushrooms. Contains calcium and **protein** from Parmesan cheese.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Arborio rice 1.5 cups
2. Mushrooms 400g, sliced
3. Celery 2 stalks, diced
4. Sundried tomatoes 1/2 cup chopped
5. Cooking cream 200ml
6. Vegetable broth 3 cups warm
7. Onion 1, diced
8. Garlic 3 cloves minced
9. Parmesan cheese
10. Butter 2 tbsp
11. Olive oil
12. White wine 1/2 cup (optional)
13. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid Multi Cooker:**

1. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add olive oil and butter.
2. Sauté mushrooms 8-10 min until browned. Remove, set aside.
3. Add more oil if needed. Sauté onion and celery 5 min until soft.
4. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
5. Add rice, stir 2 min until slightly toasted.
6. Add wine if using, stir until absorbed.
7. Add sundried tomatoes and all the broth at once.
8. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 6 min.
9. When done, quick release pressure.
10. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode.
11. Stir in cooked mushrooms and cooking cream.
12. Stir constantly for 3-5 min until creamy consistency.
13. Add parmesan, stir until melted.
14. Season with salt and pepper.
15. Serve immediately with extra parmesan.

**Time saved:** 20 minutes; no constant stirring required during pressure cooking phase
recipes.image_description: Image of a creamy mushroom risotto in a wide bowl, garnished with Parmesan cheese and fresh herbs.

nutrition.highlights: High in Carbohydrates for energy. Contains fiber from beans and spinach. Offers Vitamin K and minerals from the various vegetables and healthy fats from coconut milk and olives.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Rice 1.5 cups
2. Butter beans 1 tin
3. Sliced olives 1/2 cup
4. Cherry tomatoes 250g halved
5. Sundried tomatoes 1/2 cup chopped
6. Spinach 2 cups
7. Artichoke hearts 1 tin, quartered
8. Lemon juice 2 tbsp
9. Garlic 4 cloves minced
10. Coconut milk 400ml
11. Feta cheese crumbles
12. Olive oil
13. Vegetable broth 1 cup
14. Italian herbs
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid Multi Cooker:**

1. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add olive oil.
2. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
3. Add rice, stir 2 min to coat.
4. Add sundried tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, olives, artichokes.
5. Add coconut milk, vegetable broth, Italian herbs.
6. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 8 min.
7. When done, natural release 5 min, then quick release.
8. Remove lid, add butter beans (drained and rinsed) and spinach on top.
9. Select KEEP WARM mode, cover with glass lid, let sit 3 min until spinach wilted.
10. Stir in lemon juice.
11. Season with salt and pepper.
12. Top with feta crumbles before serving.

**Time saved:** 5 minutes; perfectly cooked rice every time
recipes.image_description: Image of a colorful one-pot rice dish with visible cherry tomatoes, olives, artichoke hearts, spinach, and feta crumbles on top.

nutrition.highlights: Good source of Vitamin A and Vitamin C from the vegetables. Contains healthy fats from olive oil and richness from cooking cream. High in fiber if using wholemeal bread.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Tomatoes 1 kg
2. Capsicum 1
3. Onion 1
4. Garlic 4 cloves
5. Olive oil
6. Cooking cream 200ml
7. Italian herbs
8. Grated cheese
9. Bread for serving
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid Multi Cooker:**

1. Dice onion and capsicum. Mince garlic. Roughly chop tomatoes.
2. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add olive oil to pot.
3. Sauté onion and capsicum 5 min until soft.
4. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
5. Add tomatoes, herbs, salt and pepper.
6. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 10 min.
7. When done, quick release pressure.
8. Use immersion blender directly in pot. Blend until smooth.
9. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode again.
10. Stir in cooking cream, heat through 2-3 min.
11. Serve topped with grated cheese and bread.

**Time saved:** 5 minutes compared to stovetop method
recipes.image_description: Image of a bowl of creamy red tomato soup topped with grated cheese, served with a slice of crusty bread on the side.

nutrition.highlights: Low in calories and fat (if using less oil/butter). Good source of potassium and B vitamins from mushrooms and potatoes. Provides a comforting and creamy texture.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Mushrooms 500g sliced
2. Potatoes 8 medium, diced
3. Cooking cream 200ml
4. Cheese spread 2-3 tbsp
5. Mushroom broth 1.5L (or vegetable broth)
6. Onion 1, diced
7. Garlic 3 cloves minced
8. Olive oil or butter
9. Salt and pepper
10. Fresh herbs (thyme or parsley)
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid Multi Cooker:**

1. Dice onion and potatoes. Slice mushrooms. Mince garlic.
2. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add oil or butter.
3. Sauté onion 5 min until soft.
4. Add mushrooms, cook 8-10 min until browned.
5. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
6. Add diced potatoes, stir.
7. Add broth.
8. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 8 min.
9. When done, quick release pressure.
10. Use immersion blender to partially blend (leave some chunks).
11. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode.
12. Stir in cooking cream and cheese spread.
13. Heat through 5 min, stirring until cheese melted.
14. Season with salt and pepper.
15. Garnish with fresh herbs.

**Time saved:** 10 minutes; potatoes cook faster under pressure
recipes.image_description: Image of a rustic bowl of creamy mushroom soup with fresh herbs, showing some visible mushroom and potato chunks.

nutrition.highlights: High in Vitamin A (from butternut squash and carrots) and Vitamin C (from tomatoes). Good source of fiber. Naturally creamy and comforting, with healthy fats from olive oil and optional nuts/seeds.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Large tomatoes 3
2. Carrots 3, chopped
3. Onion 1, diced
4. Garlic 4 cloves
5. Butternut squash 1 medium (about 1kg), peeled and cubed
6. Vegetable broth 1.5L
7. Olive oil
8. Cooking cream or coconut milk 200ml
9. Nuts and seeds for topping (pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds)
10. Salt and pepper
11. Cumin 1 tsp (optional)
recipes.instructions:

1. Dice onion, chop carrots and tomatoes, cube squash, mince garlic.
2. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add olive oil.
3. Sauté onion 5 min until soft.
4. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
5. Add carrots, squash, tomatoes, stir 2 min.
6. Add vegetable broth and cumin if using.
7. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK mode, set 10 min.
8. When done, natural release 5 min, then quick release.
9. Use immersion blender directly in pot. Blend until smooth.
10. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode.
11. Stir in cream or coconut milk.
12. Heat through 3-5 min.
13. Season with salt and pepper.
14. Toast nuts and seeds in dry pan.
15. Serve soup topped with toasted nuts and seeds.

**Time saved:** 20 minutes; vegetables cook much faster under pressure
recipes.image_description: Image of a rustic bowl of creamy pumpkin soup garnished with toasted seeds and fresh herbs.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 3
2. Sugar 120g
3. Carrots 220g
4. Sunflower oil 30ml
5. Flour 110g
6. Corn starch 15g
7. Baking powder 1 tsp
8. Salt 0.5 tsp
9. Cinnamon 1 tsp
10. Cream cheese 250g
11. Heavy cream 33% 200ml
12. Powdered sugar 120g
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend or finely grate carrots.
2. Whisk eggs and sugar, fold in carrots and oil.
3. Fold in sifted dry ingredients.
4. Spread thin on a lined sheet pan (45x33cm), bake at 180C until set.
5. Whip cream cheese, cream and powdered sugar for filling.
6. Spread filling on cooled sponge, roll up tightly, chill before slicing.
recipes.image_description: Sliced carrot cake roll showing spiral of cream filling

recipes.ingredients:
1. Cookies 200g
2. Butter 80g
3. Cream cheese 600g
4. Lemon juice 20g
5. Powdered sugar 150g
6. Eggs 4
7. Heavy cream 33% 150g
8. Lemon juice (curd) from 1.5 lemons
9. Eggs (curd) 3
10. Sugar (curd) 130g
11. Butter (curd) 90g
12. Lemon zest 1 lemon
13. Corn starch 1.5 tsp
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend cookies to crumbs, mix with melted butter, press into 20cm pan, bake 10 min at 180C.
2. Whisk cream cheese, eggs, lemon juice, sugar, cream gently (do not overmix).
3. Wrap pan in foil, bake in water bath 40 min at 180C.
4. Cool completely.
5. Combine curd ingredients, cook over water bath until thick, chill in ice bath, strain.
6. Pour curd over cooled cheesecake, refrigerate 8 hours.
recipes.image_description: Baked cheesecake topped with glossy yellow lemon curd

recipes.dish_name: Cottage Cheese Bun with Poppy Seeds
recipes.ingredients:
1. Cottage cheese 200g
2. Eggs 2
3. Flour 250g
4. Sweetener or sugar to taste
5. Salt pinch
6. Poppy seeds 100g
7. Milk or water 100g
8. Butter 30g
recipes.instructions:
1. Soak poppy seeds 20-30 min.
2. Mix dough ingredients, rest 10 min.
3. Cook drained poppy seeds with milk until liquid evaporates, add butter, cool.
4. Roll out dough, spread filling, roll into log, cut and braid.
5. Brush with yolk, bake in air fryer 25 min at 180C.
recipes.image_description: Braided curd bun with poppy seed filling, golden crust

recipes.ingredients:
1. Sugar 120g
2. Eggs 4
3. Flour 100g
4. Corn starch 24g
5. Salt pinch
6. Cream cheese 35g
7. Butter 82.5% 100g
8. Boiled condensed milk 50g
9. Chopped walnuts 30g
10. Milk chocolate 200g
11. Cocoa butter 20g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip eggs and sugar to pale foam, fold in sifted flour and starch.
2. Bake sponge at 180C, cool, break into crumbs.
3. Mix cream cheese, butter, condensed milk, walnuts into crumbs to form pliable mass.
4. Shape into 50g potato shapes, freeze 30 min.
5. Melt chocolate and cocoa butter, dip shapes, chill until set.
recipes.image_description: Chocolate-glazed potato-shaped pastries dusted with cocoa

recipes.ingredients:
1. Grainy cottage cheese 320g
2. Eggs 2
3. Vanillin 1 tsp
4. Ricotta 40g
5. Cherries as needed
6. Sugar 1 tbsp
7. Corn starch 1 tbsp
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend cottage cheese, eggs, vanillin until smooth.
2. Spread onto parchment, bake at 180C until golden.
3. Cool, spread with ricotta, add cherries, roll up.
4. Optionally cook cherries with sugar and starch into thick sauce.
5. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
recipes.image_description: Sliced cheese roll with visible cherry and ricotta filling

recipes.ingredients:
1. Farmer's cheese block 500g
2. Egg yolks 2
3. Flour 1-2 tbsp
4. Sugar 2 tbsp
5. Salt and vanillin pinch
recipes.instructions:
1. Press excess liquid from cheese if wet, or sieve if grainy.
2. Mix in yolks, sugar, salt, vanillin.
3. Form patties, coat lightly in flour.
4. Pan-fry until golden on both sides.
recipes.image_description: Golden fried cheese pancakes on a plate with fork

recipes.ingredients:
1. Egg 1
2. Honey 170g
3. Sugar 100g
4. Baking soda 1 tsp
5. Butter 125g
6. Flour 400g
7. Cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, cardamom, white pepper, cloves to taste
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt honey and sugar together until dissolved.
2. Add baking soda off heat, mixture will foam.
3. Stir in spices, then butter.
4. Cool to 60C, mix in egg, then flour to form dough.
5. Chill 30 min before using for cookies.
recipes.image_description: Ball of spiced gingerbread dough on floured surface

recipes.ingredients:
1. Red apples 5
2. Flour 1/2 cup
3. Sugar 1/2 cup
4. Melted butter 3 tbsp
5. Warm milk 150ml
6. Vanilla 1 packet
7. Baking powder 1 packet
8. Eggs 4
9. Powdered sugar for dusting
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all batter ingredients except apples until smooth.
2. Slice apples thinly, fold into batter.
3. Pour into lined 30cm pan.
4. Bake at 180C for 35-40 min until browned.
5. Rest 10-15 min before serving, dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.image_description: Golden apple pie with visible apple slices on top

recipes.dish_name: Carrot Cake with Walnuts and Apricots
recipes.ingredients:
1. Light spelt flour 200g
2. Sugar 110g
3. Eggs 3
4. Neutral vegetable oil 130ml
5. Grated carrots 160g
6. Dried apricots 70g
7. Walnuts 70g
8. Baking powder 1 tsp
9. Cinnamon 3g
10. Vanilla pinch
11. Salt 2g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip eggs and sugar 5-7 min until fluffy, add oil.
2. Sift flour with baking powder, cinnamon, salt, add to wet mixture.
3. Fold in carrots, chopped apricots and walnuts.
4. Pour into lined pan, bake 40 min at 180C.
5. Check with toothpick, cool before serving.
recipes.image_description: Rustic carrot cake slice with visible nuts and apricot pieces

recipes.dish_name: Caramel San Sebastian Cheesecake with Chocolate Sponge
recipes.ingredients:
1. Cream cheese 400g
2. Heavy cream 33% 80ml
3. Boiled condensed milk 220g
4. Eggs 3
5. Powdered sugar 80g
6. Vanilla sugar 10g
7. Lemon juice 1 tsp
8. Corn starch 15g
9. Flour 100g
10. Butter 50g (sponge)
11. Sugar 100g (sponge)
12. Egg 1 (sponge)
13. Milk 100ml (sponge)
14. Cocoa 20g
15. Baking powder 5g
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix sponge dry ingredients, add milk, egg, soft butter, blend until smooth.
2. Pour sponge batter into 18cm ring, bake 220C for 10-15 min until top sets.
3. Whip cream cheese with sugars until creamy.
4. Add condensed milk, then eggs one at a time.
5. Add cream, then starch and lemon juice, mix to smooth batter.
6. Pour cheese batter over sponge, bake until caramelized top forms.
7. Cool completely before slicing.
recipes.image_description: Dark caramelized cheesecake with chocolate sponge base

recipes.ingredients:
1. Grainy cottage cheese 320g
2. Eggs 2
3. Vanillin 1 tsp
4. Ricotta 40g
5. Strawberries as needed
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend cheese, eggs, vanillin until smooth.
2. Bake thin layer on parchment at 180C until golden.
3. Cool, spread with ricotta, add sliced strawberries, roll up.
4. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
recipes.image_description: Rolled cheese cake with strawberry filling, dusted sugar

recipes.ingredients:
1. Puff pastry (yeast-free) 500g
2. Cherries 500g
3. Walnuts 80g
4. Breadcrumbs 80g
5. Melted butter 1 tbsp
6. Sugar 50g
7. Egg 1
8. Corn starch 1 tbsp
9. Flour for dusting
10. Powdered sugar to serve
recipes.instructions:
1. Drain cherries on a sieve.
2. Chop walnuts finely.
3. Roll pastry into thin sheets, brush with butter.
4. Sprinkle breadcrumbs and walnuts, add cherries and sugar.
5. Roll into tight logs, place on baking sheet.
6. Brush with beaten egg, bake 170-180C about 25 min.
7. Dust with powdered sugar to serve.
recipes.image_description: Sliced strudel roll showing cherry and nut filling

recipes.dish_name: Strawberry Pie with Sour Cream Custard
recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 200g
2. Butter 100g
3. Sugar 2-3 tbsp
4. Salt pinch
5. Baking powder 1 tsp
6. Sour cream 70-100g
7. Strawberries 400g
8. Coconut flakes 2-3 tbsp
9. Sugar (base) 2 tbsp
10. Corn starch (base) 1 tbsp
11. Sugar (custard) 120-140g
12. Egg 1
13. Corn starch (custard) 2-3 tbsp
14. Salt pinch
15. Sour cream 20-30% 250g
recipes.instructions:
1. Rub flour, baking powder, sugar and butter into crumbs.
2. Add sour cream, form dough, chill.
3. Slice strawberries.
4. Mix coconut base with sugar and starch.
5. Mix custard ingredients until smooth.
6. Roll dough, sprinkle coconut mix on bottom, add berries, pour custard.
7. Bake 50-60 min at 185-190C.
8. Cool fully before slicing.
recipes.image_description: Custard strawberry pie slice on a plate

nutrition.highlights: Layered crepes, no baking of cake

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 220g
2. Eggs 80g
3. Warm water 230g
4. Milk 3.2% 360g
5. Vegetable oil 32g
6. Baking powder 14g
7. Sugar 40g
8. Salt 1-2g
9. Heavy cream 33-35% 200g
10. Raspberry puree 40g
11. Soft cottage cheese 5-9% 250g
12. Powdered sugar 30g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk eggs and sugar, add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk and water.
2. Stir in oil last.
3. Cook thin crepes on hot pan until golden both sides.
4. Whip cream and powdered sugar to stiff peaks, fold in cottage cheese and puree.
5. Layer crepes with cream between each.
6. Chill 30-40 min before serving.
recipes.image_description: Layered crepe cake slice with pink berry cream

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 2
2. Sugar 200g
3. Salt pinch
4. Honey 3 tbsp
5. Butter 82.5% 100g
6. Baking soda 1 tsp heaping
7. Flour 400g plus 100g for dusting
8. Milk 400ml
9. Sugar (cream) 180g
10. Eggs (cream) 2
11. Butter (cream) 100g
12. Corn starch 50g
13. Heavy cream 33% 400ml
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine eggs, sugar, salt, butter, honey in saucepan, heat gently while stirring.
2. Add baking soda, mixture will foam and double.
3. Off heat, mix in flour gradually to form dough.
4. Divide into 10 balls, chill 30 min.
5. Roll each thin, bake 5 min at 170C per layer.
6. Make pastry cream with milk, egg, sugar, starch; cool completely.
7. Add butter to cream, then fold in whipped cream.
8. Assemble layers with cream, chill overnight, crumb-coat with leftover cake scraps.
recipes.image_description: Tall layered honey cake coated in cake crumbs

recipes.ingredients:
1. Yeasted puff pastry 1000g
2. Sugar to taste
3. Cinnamon to taste
4. Melted butter as needed
recipes.instructions:
1. Cut pastry into squares.
2. Dip each square into melted butter.
3. Coat in cinnamon sugar mixture.
4. Bake according to pastry package instructions until golden.
recipes.image_description: Buttery cinnamon sugar coated pastry squares

recipes.ingredients:
1. Baked bananas 4 large
2. Demerara sugar 150g
3. Egg 1
4. Banana puree 280g
5. Flour 160g
6. Cocoa powder 50g
7. Baking powder 15g
8. Butter 140g
9. Dark chocolate 160g
recipes.instructions:
1. Bake bananas at 170C until darkened, peel and mash 3.
2. Whisk egg, sugar and banana puree into foam.
3. Add flour, cocoa, baking powder.
4. Fold in melted butter (40C) and dark chocolate.
5. Pour into loaf pan, place a whole banana in center.
6. Bake at 160C until done.
7. Wrap and chill 6 hours for dense texture.
recipes.image_description: Dark chocolate banana bread slices with banana center

recipes.ingredients:
1. Canned pineapple rings 1 can
2. Flour 160g
3. Baking powder 1 tsp
4. Baking soda 1/4 tsp
5. White sugar 220g
6. Brown sugar 100g
7. Butter 180g
8. Eggs 2
9. Sour cream 120g
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt part of butter with white and brown sugar for caramel layer.
2. Cream remaining butter and sugars until smooth.
3. Add eggs one at a time, then sour cream.
4. Add flour, baking powder, soda.
5. Pour caramel into pan, top with pineapple rings.
6. Pour batter over pineapple carefully.
7. Bake 180C for 40-50 min, check with toothpick.
recipes.image_description: Upside-down cake with caramelized pineapple rings on top

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 230g
2. Panela sugar 230g
3. Dark chocolate 180g
4. Butter 82.5% 280g
5. Peanut butter 50g
6. Flour 85g
7. Cocoa powder 25g
8. Roasted hazelnuts 150g
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix eggs and panela sugar gently.
2. Melt chocolate to 35-40C, whisk in soft butter and peanut butter.
3. Combine chocolate mixture with egg mixture.
4. Add flour, cocoa, and chopped roasted hazelnuts.
5. Divide between two 16x16cm foil-lined pans.
6. Bake at 170C for 27-30 min.
7. Cool completely, cut into cubes, top with sea salt flakes.
recipes.image_description: Fudgy brownie squares topped with flaky sea salt

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 160g
2. Cocoa powder 30g
3. Butter 110g
4. Dark chocolate 100g
5. Dark beer or strong coffee 125ml
6. Eggs 4
7. Dark cane sugar 200g
8. White sugar 200g
9. Vanilla extract 2 tsp
10. Salt pinch
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flour, cocoa, salt.
2. Brown butter over medium heat, remove from heat.
3. Stir in chopped chocolate until melted, add beer.
4. Whip eggs and both sugars until fluffy.
5. Add vanilla, slowly stream in chocolate mixture.
6. Fold in dry ingredients gently.
7. Bake at 180C for 30-45 min, wrap overnight for best texture.
recipes.image_description: Dense chocolate brownie squares stacked on plate

recipes.ingredients:
1. Butter 125g
2. Sugar 150g
3. Eggs 3
4. Flour 300g
5. Baking powder 1.5 tsp
6. Vanilla extract 3g
7. Salt pinch
8. Milk 75ml
9. Filling of choice (chocolate, toffee, berries, fruit)
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs one at a time.
3. Add dry ingredients and milk, mix to thick batter.
4. Pipe half batter into liners, add filling, top with more batter.
5. Bake at 175C for 15-20 min until golden.
recipes.image_description: Muffins with visible chocolate filling in paper liners

recipes.ingredients:
1. Lemon zest 1 lemon
2. Eggs 3
3. Flour 80g
4. Cocoa powder 50g
5. Sugar 120g
6. Milk 300ml
7. Cherries as needed
recipes.instructions:
1. Zest lemon into a bowl.
2. Add flour, cocoa, eggs, sugar, milk.
3. Whisk to thin batter.
4. Arrange cherries in oiled 16cm dish.
5. Pour batter over carefully.
6. Bake at 180C 30-50 min until toothpick clean.
7. Cool slightly, dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.image_description: Chocolate clafoutis with cherries baked in a round dish

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 100g
2. Sugar 60g
3. Milk 200ml
4. Eggs 4
5. Butter 50g
6. Berries 300g
7. Salt pinch
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine flour, sugar, salt.
2. Add milk, then eggs one at a time.
3. Add melted butter.
4. Arrange berries in oiled 20cm pan.
5. Pour batter over, don't fill above halfway.
6. Bake 200C 12-15 min, then 180C 25-30 min more.
7. Cool 5 min before serving.
recipes.image_description: Golden clafoutis studded with strawberries

recipes.ingredients:
1. Pears 3
2. Cane sugar 250g
3. Butter 225g
4. Flour 450g
5. Ginger 1 tsp
6. Cinnamon 1 tsp
7. Baking soda 1 tsp
8. Nutmeg 1 tsp
9. Honey 370g
10. Eggs 3
11. Yogurt 2% 250g
12. Heavy cream 33% 80g
recipes.instructions:
1. Caramelize pears in butter and brown sugar until translucent.
2. Mix flour, soda, spices.
3. Beat sugar and butter until pale, add honey.
4. Add eggs one at a time.
5. Alternate adding dry mix and yogurt.
6. Arrange pears in pan bottom, pour batter over.
7. Bake at 160C 50-80 min.
8. Make caramel sauce from pear syrup and cream, drizzle over cake.
recipes.image_description: Golden porous cake with caramelized pear topping

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 380g
2. Baking powder 2 tsp
3. Baking soda 1 tsp
4. Cinnamon 1 tsp
5. Ginger 1 tsp
6. Cane sugar 100g
7. White sugar 100g
8. Butter 115g
9. Eggs 2
10. Yogurt 3% 250g
11. Pear 1 large
12. Crumble flour 40g
13. Crumble cane sugar 45g
14. Crumble butter 25g
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine dry ingredients and sugars.
2. Melt butter, whisk in eggs and yogurt.
3. Combine wet and dry mixtures.
4. Fold in diced pear.
5. Make crumble by rubbing cold butter into flour and sugar.
6. Spread batter in pan, top with crumble.
7. Bake 175-180C for 25-35 min until golden.
recipes.image_description: Pear pie topped with golden crumble squares

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 235g
2. Baking soda 7g
3. Salt 4g
4. Cocoa powder 65g
5. Sugar 300g
6. Eggs 2
7. Butter 60g
8. Vegetable oil 60g
9. Vanilla extract 10g
10. Milk 260g
11. Wine vinegar 7g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk flour, soda, salt, sugar, cocoa together.
2. Add eggs, butter, oil, vanilla, milk, vinegar.
3. Mix with electric mixer 3-4 min until smooth.
4. Pour into greased pan, filling only halfway.
5. Bake at 155C for 50-90 min until toothpick clean.
6. Wrap cooled cake in plastic 2+ hours before serving.
recipes.image_description: Simple moist chocolate cake with cracked top

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 225g
2. Baking powder 2 tsp
3. Baking soda 1 tsp
4. Salt pinch
5. Ginger 1 tsp
6. Sugar 100g
7. Butter 100g
8. Honey 100g
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine dry ingredients.
2. Add cold cubed butter, mix to crumbs.
3. Add honey, mix to slightly moist dough.
4. Roll into balls, coat in sugar.
5. Place on parchment 5cm apart, flatten slightly.
6. Bake at 180C for 10-12 min until cracks turn golden.
recipes.image_description: Golden crackled honey cookies on baking sheet

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 190g
2. Baking powder 1 tsp
3. Baking soda 1/4 tsp
4. White sugar 100g
5. Cane sugar 95g
6. Vegetable oil 120ml
7. Eggs 2
8. Citrus juice 30ml
9. Yogurt 80ml
10. Sugar (syrup) 2 tbsp
11. Citrus juice (syrup) 40ml
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flour, baking powder, soda.
2. Combine sugars with zest, whisk in oil.
3. Add eggs, then juice and yogurt.
4. Fold in dry ingredients.
5. Bake in loaf pan at 180C for 40+ min.
6. Make syrup, poke bread and soak while warm.
recipes.image_description: Sliced citrus loaf bread with glossy syrup glaze

recipes.ingredients:
1. Butter 225g
2. Sugar 225g
3. Flour 225g
4. Baking powder 2 tsp
5. Eggs 4
6. Mandarins 3
7. Brown sugar 40g
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream sugar and butter.
2. Add eggs one at a time.
3. Add flour and baking powder.
4. Sprinkle sugar on bottom of muffin cups, top with mandarin slices.
5. Pipe batter over fruit.
6. Bake at 180C for 20-30 min.
7. Invert while warm so fruit soaks in.
recipes.image_description: Mandarin-topped cupcakes with caramelized fruit base

recipes.ingredients:
1. Butter 60g
2. Sugar 100g
3. Egg white 1
4. Lemon 1 (zest and juice)
5. Corn starch 40g
6. Flour 180-200g
7. Baking powder 1 tsp
recipes.instructions:
1. Beat butter and sugar until fluffy.
2. Add egg white, zest, juice.
3. Add corn starch, then flour gradually.
4. Roll into balls, flatten with a glass.
5. Bake at 175C for 8-12 min.
recipes.image_description: Pale round lemon cookies on parchment paper

recipes.ingredients:
1. Egg whites 2
2. Sugar 70g
3. Almond flour 80g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip egg whites, add sugar gradually to stiff peaks.
2. Sift in nut flour, fold gently.
3. Pipe onto parchment.
4. Bake at 150C for 40 min until golden and releasing easily.
5. Cool on rack.
recipes.image_description: Piped almond meringue cookies golden and crisp

recipes.dish_name: Berry Scones with Whole Wheat Flour
recipes.ingredients:
1. Wheat flour 125g
2. Whole wheat flour 120g
3. Lemon zest 1 lemon
4. Cane sugar 30g
5. Baking powder 2 tsp
6. Cold butter 70g
7. Milk 150g
8. Fresh berries 150g
9. Egg and sugar for glazing
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine flours, zest, sugar, baking powder.
2. Rub in cold butter to crumbs.
3. Fold in berries carefully.
4. Add milk, fold to dough.
5. Shape into disk, cut into 8 wedges.
6. Brush with egg, sprinkle sugar.
7. Bake at 205C until golden.
recipes.image_description: Berry scones wedges with golden brushed tops

recipes.dish_name: Double Lemon Poppy Seed Cake from Shanghai
recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 175g
2. Baking powder 1 tsp
3. Butter 175g
4. Sugar 175g
5. Eggs 3
6. Lemon zest 2-3 lemons
7. Lemon juice 40g
8. Poppy seeds 40g
9. Lemon juice (syrup) 70-100g
10. Sugar (syrup) equal to juice
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift flour and baking powder.
2. Add soft butter, zest, juice, sugar.
3. Add eggs and poppy seeds, mix until smooth.
4. Bake at 170C for 30-40 min in 18-20cm pan.
5. Make syrup from lemon juice and sugar.
6. Poke cake and pour syrup over while warm.
recipes.image_description: Lemon poppy seed loaf cake with syrup glaze

recipes.ingredients:
1. Shortbread cookies 120g
2. Salted breadsticks 50g
3. Butter 180g
4. Sugar 200g
5. Water 50g
6. Heavy cream 220g
7. Cream cheese 100g
8. Bananas 2
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend cookies and breadsticks to crumbs.
2. Mix with melted butter, press into ring, chill.
3. Cook sugar and water to caramel, add butter and cream.
4. Pour caramel over base.
5. Layer banana slices on top.
6. Whip cream with cream cheese, spread on top.
7. Chill 2+ hours before serving.
recipes.image_description: Layered banoffee pie with banana and caramel

recipes.ingredients:
1. Pears 4
2. Cinnamon sticks 3-4
3. Saffron 0.3g
4. Vanilla pods 2
5. Sugar 300g
6. Dessert wine 350g
7. Butter 220g
8. Sugar (frangipane) 250g
9. Eggs 4
10. Almond flour 310g
recipes.instructions:
1. Poach peeled pears in spiced wine syrup for 1 hour, cool in liquid.
2. Beat soft butter and sugar until pale.
3. Add eggs one at a time.
4. Fold in almond flour.
5. Spread frangipane in 25x25cm pan, arrange pears on top.
6. Bake at 170C for 35-40 min.
7. Serve with reserved pear syrup.
recipes.image_description: Golden frangipane tart with poached pear halves

recipes.ingredients:
1. Powdered sugar 110g
2. Flour 15g
3. Almond flour 125g
4. Butter 80g
5. Eggs 125g
6. Candied fruit 50g
7. Powdered sugar (glaze) 200g
8. Orange juice 35g
recipes.instructions:
1. Sift powdered sugar and flour into bowl.
2. Add almond flour, mix.
3. Add eggs, mix until uniform.
4. Pour in melted butter, fold in candied fruit.
5. Pipe into small molds.
6. Bake at 160C for 10-18 min.
7. Cool, then glaze with orange icing.
recipes.image_description: Small glazed orange cakes cooling on rack

nutrition.highlights: Fast prep, chocolate and pumpkin seeds

recipes.ingredients:
1. Chocolate 180g
2. Pumpkin seeds 60g
3. Pear 1
4. Sugar 150g
5. Butter 150g
6. Eggs 3
7. Flour 150g
8. Baking powder 1 tsp
recipes.instructions:
1. Chop chocolate and seeds.
2. Cube pear finely.
3. Beat sugar and butter, add eggs.
4. Fold in flour and baking powder.
5. Add chocolate, pear, and seeds.
6. Bake in 18cm pan at 160C until done.
recipes.image_description: Rustic pie slice with visible chocolate chunks and pear

recipes.dish_name: Very Lemon Cake with Blueberry & Streusel
recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 300g
2. Baking powder 10g
3. Sugar 260g
4. Lemon zest from 3 lemons
5. Butter 170g
6. Eggs 3
7. Cream cheese 70g
8. Milk 90g
9. Blueberries 100g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk flour and baking powder.
2. Mix cream cheese and milk.
3. Beat sugar, butter, zest.
4. Add eggs one at a time.
5. Alternate dry mix and cheese mixture.
6. Fold in floured blueberries.
7. Bake at 180C for 40-60 min.
8. Wrap overnight in pan.
recipes.image_description: Blueberry lemon loaf cake with streusel topping

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 185g
2. Baking powder 6g
3. Cocoa powder 6g
4. Almond flour 75g
5. Butter 185g
6. Sugar 150g
7. Vanilla extract 1 tbsp
8. Eggs 3
9. Red wine 180g plus 150-200g for soaking
10. Heavy cream 200g
11. Powdered sugar 30g
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flour, baking powder, cocoa, almond flour.
2. Beat butter, sugar, vanilla until fluffy.
3. Add eggs one at a time.
4. Gradually add wine.
5. Fold in dry ingredients.
6. Bake at 170C for 30-50 min.
7. Soak with additional wine, cool.
8. Serve with whipped cream and grapes.
recipes.image_description: Dark burgundy cake slice with whipped cream and grapes

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 120g
2. Banana 255g
3. Sugar 50g
4. Baking powder 18g
5. Egg 1
6. Vegetable oil 75g
7. Cream cheese 450g
8. Powdered sugar 50g
9. Heavy cream 50g
10. Egg yolk 1
recipes.instructions:
1. Mash bananas, add oil and egg.
2. Fold in dry ingredients.
3. Whip filling ingredients until stable.
4. Layer 1/3 batter, pipe filling, top with rest.
5. Bake at 170C 30-40 min.
6. Cool completely, invert.
recipes.image_description: Sliced casserole showing creamy banana center

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 150g
2. Sugar 150g
3. Butter 60g
4. Flour 150g
5. Milk 250g
6. Vanilla pod 1
7. Gelatin 5g
8. Egg yolks 60g

10. Flour (cream) 25g
11. Pistachio paste 30g
12. Heavy cream 70g
13. Pectin NH 5g
14. Strawberry puree 100g
15. Strawberries 100g
recipes.instructions:
1. Make genoise sponge with eggs, sugar, butter, flour, bake, cool.
2. Make diplomat cream with milk, yolks, sugar, flour, pistachio paste, gelatin.
3. Cook compote with strawberry puree, sugar and pectin.
4. Assemble in ring with sponge, strawberry halves along wall, cream, compote, second sponge, more cream.
5. Chill to set, glaze with strawberry mirror glaze.
recipes.image_description: Elegant strawberry cake with visible fruit border

recipes.ingredients:
1. Sugar 200g
2. Butter 45g
3. Apples 6-7
4. Sugar (glaze) 40g
5. Tea 150g
6. Vanilla pod 1
7. Shortbread dough as needed
recipes.instructions:
1. Make dry caramel with sugar, add butter.
2. Pour thin, cool, blend to powder.
3. Slice apples thinly.
4. Layer caramel powder and apple slices in ring.
5. Bake at 150-160C for 1.5-3 hours, basting with juices.
6. Make tea-vanilla glaze separately.
7. Bake shortbread round, top apples, invert, glaze.
recipes.image_description: Golden layered apple tart with glossy glaze

recipes.ingredients:
1. Sugar 90g
2. Eggs 2
3. Egg yolk 1
4. Carrot 150g
5. Sugar (caramel) 90g
6. Water 20g
7. Butter 130g
8. Flour 165g
9. Baking powder 8g
10. Milk 75g
11. Cinnamon 1 tsp
12. Ginger 1 tsp
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip sugar, eggs and yolk 10-15 min.
2. Cook caramel from sugar and water, add butter.
3. Add carrot, simmer 5 min.
4. Fold dry ingredients into egg foam.
5. Add milk, fold in carrot caramel.
6. Bake at 150C for 40-60 min.
7. Decorate with whipped cream and candied carrot ribbons.
recipes.image_description: Bright orange carrot pie with cream and carrot ribbon garnish

recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 480g
2. Baking powder 5g
3. Butter 225g
4. Sugar 225g
5. Eggs 2
6. Cinnamon 15g
7. Sugar (coating) 75g
8. Cinnamon (coating) 10g
recipes.instructions:
1. Beat butter, sugar, cinnamon until paste.
2. Add eggs one at a time.
3. Fold in dry ingredients to form dough.
4. Chill 30 min.
5. Roll balls, coat in cinnamon sugar.
6. Bake at 200C for 10-12 min.
recipes.image_description: Crackled cinnamon sugar cookies on cooling rack

recipes.dish_name: Lemon Tart with Basil - Modern Cube
recipes.ingredients:
1. Sablé dough with hazelnut flour and zest
2. Milk 35g
3. Heavy cream 65g
4. Basil leaves 20
5. Egg yolk 15g
6. Sugar 25g
7. Corn starch 5g
8. Butter 8g
9. Gelatin 1g
10. Butter (frangipane) 70g
11. Sugar (frangipane) 70g
12. Hazelnut flour 70g
13. Egg (frangipane) 80g
14. Lemons 4
15. Limes 2
16. Egg yolks (curd) 120g
17. Corn starch (curd) 20g
18. Heavy cream (curd) 50g
19. Butter (curd) 150g
20. Gelatin (curd) 3g
21. Egg whites (meringue) 120g
22. Sugar (meringue) 200g
recipes.instructions:
1. Prepare and bake sablé squares.
2. Make basil creme with infused cream, freeze in small molds.
3. Bake frangipane, cut to size.
4. Make lemon-lime curd, pipe into cube mold with frozen basil insert.
5. Make Italian meringue with hot syrup method.
6. Assemble sablé, frangipane, curd cube, top with meringue, shape into cube, torch.
recipes.image_description: Modern cube-shaped lemon tart with torched meringue

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 2
2. Sugar 60g
3. Flour 60g
4. Espresso 125g plus 200g for soaking
5. Powdered sugar 50g
6. Mascarpone 250g
7. Heavy cream 250g
8. Egg yolks 4
9. Gelatin 10g
10. Alcohol (Marsala or Kahlua) 25g
11. Cocoa powder for dusting
recipes.instructions:
1. Bake two savoiardi-style sponge discs.
2. Reduce espresso to syrup.
3. Whip yolks and sugar over double boiler.
4. Warm mascarpone, fold in yolks, then whipped cream.
5. Add gelatin and espresso syrup.
6. Soak sponge discs with espresso-alcohol mix.
7. Layer sponge and cream in ring, freeze 4-5 hours.
8. Dust with cocoa before serving.
recipes.image_description: Layered coffee cake dusted with cocoa powder

recipes.ingredients:
1. Mandarins 200g
2. Fresh ginger 2cm
3. Eggs 3
4. Sugar 200g
5. Butter 70g
6. Flour 80g
7. Hazelnut flour 240g
8. Baking powder 3g
9. Small mandarins for decoration
recipes.instructions:
1. Boil and puree mandarins.
2. Whip eggs and sugar until fluffy.
3. Fold in mandarin puree and grated ginger.
4. Add melted butter, then dry ingredients.
5. Bake at 160C for 1 hour.
6. Decorate with syrup-cooked mandarin slices.
recipes.image_description: Golden citrus cake garnished with mandarin slices

recipes.ingredients:
1. Prunes 100g
2. Earl Grey tea 4g
3. Egg yolks 120g
4. Sugar 120g
5. Cognac or Marsala 120g
recipes.instructions:
1. Soak prunes in brewed Earl Grey tea, drain.
2. Weigh egg yolks, match with equal weight sugar.
3. Whip yolks and sugar over double boiler on high speed until thick, pale ribbon forms.
4. Slowly stream in cognac or wine while whipping.
5. Continue whipping until thick, glossy.
6. Layer prunes in glasses, top with sabayon, serve immediately.
recipes.image_description: Glass of golden sabayon cream with prunes

recipes.ingredients:
1. Instant yeast 11g
2. Warm milk 60g
3. Sugar 15g
4. Butter 115g
5. Warm milk 125g
6. Egg 1
7. Flour 450g
8. Apples 4-5
9. Brown sugar 100g
10. Butter (filling) 25g
11. Cream cheese 150g
12. Butter (icing) 40g
13. Powdered sugar 120g
recipes.instructions:
1. Activate yeast with sugar and warm milk.
2. Mix melted butter, milk, egg, add yeast mixture.
3. Knead in flour to smooth dough, rise 1 hour.
4. Caramelize apples with brown sugar and butter.
5. Roll dough thin, spread apple filling, roll into log.
6. Cut into rolls, place in pan, rise 15 min.
7. Bake at 175C for 20-30 min.
8. Beat cream cheese icing ingredients, spread over warm rolls.
recipes.image_description: Warm cinnamon rolls with cream cheese icing

recipes.ingredients:
1. Milk chocolate 220g
2. Butter 55g
3. Eggs 2
4. Brown sugar 160g
5. Vanilla extract 6g
6. Flour 170g
7. Baking powder 5g
8. Optional: wafer crumbs 40g, dark chocolate 50g, Fleur de Sel 3g
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt chocolate and butter together gently.
2. Whip eggs and sugar until fluffy.
3. Sift flour and baking powder over eggs, fold in.
4. Fold in chocolate mixture, then optional mix-ins.
5. Chill dough 20-25 min.
6. Scoop onto sheet, space well.
7. Bake at 180C for 8-12 min, underbake slightly for gooey center.
recipes.image_description: Cracked chocolate cookies with molten center

recipes.ingredients:
1. Brown sugar 200g
2. Butter 200g
3. Cinnamon 3g
4. Nutmeg 1g
5. Eggs 4
6. Flour 250g
7. Baking powder 10g
8. Apple 1
9. Milk 130g
10. Egg yolk 1
11. Apples (topping) 400g
12. Sugar (topping) 100g
13. Apricot jam 140g
14. Gelatin 6g
recipes.instructions:
1. Cream butter, spices and brown sugar.
2. Add eggs one at a time.
3. Add flour and baking powder, then milk.
4. Fold in diced apple.
5. Bake in ring at 160C for 50-80 min.
6. Trim top, seal with egg yolk, brief second bake.
7. Cook apple topping with sugar and jam, add gelatin.
8. Arrange on cake in ring, chill 3-6 hours, glaze with warm jam.
recipes.image_description: Layered apple pie with glossy fruit topping

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 2
2. Sugar 250g
3. Lemons 2-6
4. Butter 100g
5. Yogurt 165g
6. Flour 260g
7. Baking powder 10g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip eggs and sugar to white foam.
2. Add lemon zest, melted butter, yogurt.
3. Add flour and baking powder.
4. Bake in 20-22cm form at 160C for 50-70 min.
5. Optionally soak with lemon syrup.
6. Decorate with candied lemon zest.
recipes.image_description: Golden bundt-style lemon cake with candied zest

recipes.dish_name: Pavlova with Lemon Curd and Mascarpone
recipes.ingredients:
1. Egg whites 170g
2. Sugar 230g
3. Corn starch 14g
4. Water 45g
5. Sugar (curd) 160g
6. Heavy cream 50g
7. Lemon juice 120g
8. Corn starch (curd) 8g
9. Egg yolks 105g
10. Butter 100g
11. Mascarpone 200g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip egg whites, gradually add sugar to stiff peaks.
2. Add water, then cornstarch, fold gently.
3. Shape into domed disc with center well.
4. Bake at 95C about 2 hours, cool inside oven.
5. Make lemon curd, cool to 30C, add butter.
6. Mix half curd with mascarpone 1:1.
7. Fill center with cheese cream, top with curd and fresh fruit.
recipes.image_description: White meringue nest topped with lemon curd and berries

recipes.ingredients:
1. Apples (cubed) 320g
2. Sugar 85g
3. Butter 20g
4. Sugar (dough) 100g
5. Honey 50g
6. Spice mix 5g
7. Butter (dough) 85g
8. Egg 1
9. Flour 180g
10. Baking powder 7g
11. Milk 120g
recipes.instructions:
1. Caramelize sugar, add butter then apple cubes.
2. Reserve some caramel-apple juice for batter.
3. Cream butter, sugar, honey, spices.
4. Add egg, then flour, baking powder, milk.
5. Fold in reserved juice and caramelized apples.
6. Bake in 18cm ring at 130C then 170C, about 55-60 min total.
7. Wrap and rest 8 hours before serving.
recipes.image_description: Dark caramel-colored apple cake slice

recipes.dish_name: Spiced Carrot Cake with Mascarpone Cream
recipes.ingredients:
1. Carrot 135g
2. Brown sugar 200g
3. Eggs 2
4. Walnuts 70g
5. Baking powder 5g
6. Baking soda 2.5g
7. Flour 155g
8. Apple puree 80g
9. Orange zest
10. Vegetable oil 120g
11. Cinnamon 2g
12. Nutmeg 1g
13. Mascarpone 250g
14. Powdered sugar 50g
15. Vanilla extract 5g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk eggs, sugar and orange zest.
2. Add soda and baking powder.
3. Add flour and spices, then chopped walnuts.
4. Add oil, apple puree, then grated carrot.
5. Bake at 150C in 18cm pan until done.
6. Whip mascarpone, powdered sugar, vanilla for cream.
7. Top warm cake slices with cream.
recipes.image_description: Rustic carrot cake with mascarpone cream dollop

recipes.dish_name: Apricot Pie with Whipped Yogurt Cream
recipes.ingredients:
1. Egg 1
2. Sugar 180g
3. Flour 180g
4. Baking powder 7g
5. Milk 120g
6. Butter 85g
7. Apricots 280g
8. Granella sugar 30g
9. Heavy cream 50g
10. Greek yogurt 30g
11. Powdered sugar 40g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk egg and sugar.
2. Blend milk with 80g apricots for apricot milk.
3. Add flour and baking powder.
4. Add apricot milk, then melted butter.
5. Fold in cubed apricots.
6. Top with granella sugar, bake at 160C until golden.
7. Whip yogurt cream ingredients to peaks, top pie before serving.
recipes.image_description: Apricot pie slice with whipped yogurt topping and fresh fruit

recipes.ingredients:
1. Panela sugar 40g
2. Butter 40g
3. Almond flour 40g
4. Flour 40g
5. Butter (muffin) 85g
6. Toffee caramel 200g
7. Egg 1
8. Flour (muffin) 190g
9. Baking powder 7g
10. Milk 60g
11. Heat-stable chocolate drops 100-140g
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix streusel ingredients into pliable dough, chill 1 hour.
2. Combine toffee and butter for muffin base.
3. Add egg, flour, baking powder, milk.
4. Fold in chocolate drops.
5. Fill capsules with batter, top with grated streusel.
6. Bake at 160C for 45-50 min.
7. Drizzle with extra toffee while warm.
recipes.image_description: Caramel muffins topped with streusel crumble

recipes.ingredients:
1. Butter 90g
2. Flour 200g
3. Powdered sugar 50g
4. Pistachio flour 25g
5. Egg 43g
6. Egg whites (dacquoise) 50g
7. Panela sugar 50g
8. Pistachio flour (dacquoise) 50g
9. Gelatin 4g
10. Heavy cream 80g
11. Vanilla bourbon 1 pod
12. Cream cheese 200g
13. Gelatin (confit) 4g
14. Blueberry puree 160g
recipes.instructions:
1. Make pistachio sablé dough, chill, roll, cut into base and shell for 24cm pan.
2. Blind bake sablé shell.
3. Whip dacquoise batter and pipe thin layer into shell, bake briefly.
4. Make vanilla cheesecake filling with gelatin, cream, cream cheese.
5. Fill shell with vanilla filling, chill.
6. Make blueberry confit, cool, pour over set filling.
7. Chill fully, decorate with fresh blueberries and glaze.
recipes.image_description: Full round cheesecake with blueberry topping and pistachio crust

recipes.ingredients:
1. Eggs 2
2. Panela sugar 250g
3. Butter 160g
4. Apricot puree 200g
5. Flour 340g
6. Baking powder 15g
7. Yogurt powder 22g
8. Apricots 300g
9. Pistachios 50g
10. Almond slivers 80g
recipes.instructions:
1. Whip eggs and panela sugar to foam.
2. Add melted butter, then apricot puree.
3. Add flour, baking powder, yogurt powder.
4. Fold in chopped pistachios, apricot pieces, almond slivers.
5. Bake in corrugated form at 145C for 100-110 min.
6. Wrap in plastic immediately after baking.
recipes.image_description: Rustic apricot cake with almond slivers on top

recipes.ingredients:
1. Farmer's cheese 9% 720g
2. Egg 1
3. Sugar 80g
4. Vanilla pod 1
5. Semolina 65g
6. Flour 15-20g
recipes.instructions:
1. Press cheese through a sieve for fine texture.
2. Mix egg and sugar, combine with cheese.
3. Add vanilla seeds and semolina, mix well.
4. Form 60-70g discs, dust lightly in flour.
5. Pan-fry in oil until golden both sides, about 2-3 min per side.
6. Drain on paper towel.
recipes.image_description: Tall golden cheese pancakes stacked on plate

recipes.ingredients:
1. Linden honey 20g
2. Butter 50g
3. Pistachio flour 120g
4. Panela sugar 70g
5. Flour 15g
6. Egg whites 100g
7. Fresh berries as needed
8. Neutral glaze as needed
recipes.instructions:
1. Make browned butter (beurre noisette), cool.
2. Mix pistachio flour, panela sugar, flour.
3. Add egg whites and melted honey.
4. Add browned butter, mix to smooth batter.
5. Pipe into flower-shaped molds.
6. Bake at 160C for 30-40 min.
7. Cool, cover in plastic 2 hours.
8. Top with glazed fresh berries pressed into a mound.
recipes.image_description: Flower-shaped financiers topped with glossy berries

recipes.ingredients:
1. Butter 115g
2. Demerara sugar 130g
3. Egg 1
4. Flour 150g
5. Baking powder 2g
6. Fleur de Sel 3g
7. Candied orange peel 75g
8. Milk chocolate 75g
9. Oats 60g
recipes.instructions:
1. Brown butter until nutty aroma, pour over demerara sugar.
2. Add egg, whip vigorously, cool.
3. Add sifted flour, baking powder, salt.
4. Fold in candied orange, chocolate, oats.
5. Roll into log, chill 4-12 hours.
6. Slice and bake at 160C until golden.
recipes.image_description: Oatmeal cookies studded with orange peel and chocolate

recipes.dish_name: Lemon Poppy Seed Cupcakes with Daisy Decoration
recipes.ingredients:
1. Flour 160g
2. Baking powder 8g
3. Poppy seeds 45g
4. Milk 100g
5. Lemon 2
6. Eggs 2
7. Sugar 140g
8. Honey 60g

recipes.ingredients:
1. Dried cherries 200g
2. Golden raisins 200g
3. Candied orange peel 200g
4. Dark rum 90g
5. Flour 300g
6. Milk 225g
7. Instant yeast 18g

9. Dark rum (marzipan) 20g
10. Butter (browned) 300g
11. Butter (dough) 300g
12. Spice mix 4g
13. Sugar 90g
14. Marzipan (dough) 60g
15. Salt 12g
16. Flour (dough) 450g
17. Milk (dough) 100g
recipes.instructions:
1. Soak dried fruits in rum for 24 hours.
2. Make yeast starter with flour, yeast, warm milk, rest 90 min.
3. Mix marzipan with rum, form six logs, chill.
4. Brown butter to noisette, strain, keep warm.
5. Cream butter, marzipan, sugar, salt, spices.
6. Add flour, milk, then starter.
7. Fold in soaked fruits.
8. Shape dough with marzipan filling inside, proof 1 hour.
9. Bake at 170C for 30-40 min.
10. Brush hot stollen with browned butter, dust generously with powdered sugar twice.
